scope_limit: ReleaseProof is currently bounded to reviewing supplied release requirements, test evidence, approvals, change records, rollback evidence and declared gaps for authorised human release review. It does not approve deployment, authorise a release, execute a production change or rollback, certify safety or compliance, or grant external release authority.
review_pack_title: DIO ReleaseProof Controlled Evidence Review Pack
human_gate_reason: Deployment approval, release authority, production changes, rollback execution, safety or compliance certification and final release remain with authorised release and control owners.
